parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: backs up ECS files.
OSS: backs up Alibaba Cloud OSS.
NAS: backs up Alibaba Cloud NAS.
OTS: backs up Alibaba Cloud OTS.
UDM_ECS: backs up an entire ECS instance.
SYNC: data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

ECS_FILE：备份ECS文件
OSS：备份阿里云OSS
NAS：备份阿里云NAS
OTS：备份阿里云OTS
UDM_ECS：备份ECS整机
SYNC：数据同步
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup plan. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. The backup plan name must be unique for each data source type within a single vault
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划名称。1~64个字符，单个备份仓库下每一种数据源类型的备份计划名称唯一
parameters.name: plan_name

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Set the value to COMPLETE, which indicates full backup
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。取值为COMPLETE，表示全量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en: The vault ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份仓库ID
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup policy. Format: `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This indicates that a backup job is executed at every `{interval}` starting from `{startTime}`. Backup jobs for past time periods are not compensated. If the previous backup job is not completed, the next backup job is not triggered. Example: `I|1631685600|P1D` indicates that a backup is performed once a day starting from 2021-09-15 14:00:00.

startTime: the start time of the backup. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
interval: the ISO 8601 time interval. Example: PT1H indicates an interval of one hour. P1D indicates an interval of one day
parameters.help_zh:
备份策略。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从`{startTime}`开始每隔`{interval}`的时间执行一次备份任务。不会补偿已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如`I|1631685600|P1D`表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天
parameters.name: schedule

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the backup data. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留天数，最小值为1，单位为天
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client group that executes the data synchronization plan. This parameter is required only for data synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 执行数据同步计划的客户端组ID。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to NAS. The file system ID
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统ID
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to NAS. The time when the file system was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，需要配置该参数。表示文件系统创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: create_time

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to OSS. The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，需要配置该参数。表示OSS bucket名称
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to OSS. The backup prefix. If specified, only objects that match the prefix are backed up
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为OSS时，需要配置该参数。表示备份前缀。指定后，仅备份前缀相匹配的对象
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. The ECS instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示ECS实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The details of the full-copy backup. The value is a JSON string.

snapshotGroup: specifies whether to use a consistent snapshot group. This parameter is valid only when all cloud disks of the instance are ESSDs.
appConsistent: specifies whether to use application consistency. This parameter must be used together with the preScriptPath and postScriptPath parameters.
preScriptPath: the path of the pre-freeze script.
postScriptPath: the path of the post-thaw script
parameters.help_zh:
整机备份详情，类型为JSON字符串。

snapshotGroup：是否使用一致性快照组（仅实例所有云盘均为ESSD时有效）。
appConsistent：是否使用应用一致性（需要搭配参数preScriptPath和postScriptPath使用）。
preScriptPath：冻结脚本路径。
postScriptPath：解冻脚本路径
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en: The region where the ECS instance for full-copy backup resides
parameters.help_zh: 整机备份实例所在地域
parameters.name: udm_region_id

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. The backup traffic control. Format: `{start}:{end}:{bandwidth}`. Separate multiple traffic control configurations with vertical bars (|). The time ranges of the configurations cannot overlap.

start: the start hour.
end: the end hour.
bandwidth: the rate limit. Unit: KB/s
parameters.help_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示备份流量控制。格式为`{start}:{end}:{bandwidth}`。多个流量控制配置使用|分隔，并且配置时间不允许有重叠。

start：起始小时。
end：结束小时。
bandwidth：限制速率，单位KB/s
parameters.name: speed_limit

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. The path to include in the backup. All files in this path are backed up. The value can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示需要备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: include

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. The path to exclude from the backup. All files in this path are not backed up. The value can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示不需要进行备份的路径，该路径下所有文件都不备份。最多支持255个字符
parameters.name: exclude

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required only when SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. Specifies whether to use Windows Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) to define the source path.

This feature is supported only for Windows ECS instances.
If the backup source contains data changes and you need to ensure consistency between the backup data and the source data, set this parameter to `["UseVSS":true]`.
After VSS is enabled, multiple file folders cannot be backed up simultaneously
parameters.help_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示是否使用Windows系统VSS定义备份路径。

此功能仅支持Windows类型ECS实例。
如果备份源中有数据更改，需要确保备份数据与源数据的一致时，才可配置为`["UseVSS":true]`。
选择使用VSS后，不支持多个文件目录同时备份
parameters.name: options
